diagnostics_not_added_to_primitive_price.partition_terms: Collector partition/insert source visits are represented by collection_entry_visits; do not add diagnostic again.
diagnostics_not_added_to_primitive_price.payload_terms: axpy input traversal already appears in map_entry_visits.
diagnostics_not_added_to_primitive_price.sparse_accumulations: Map and arithmetic primitives are recorded by underlying operations.
diagnostics_not_added_to_primitive_price.parent_hops: Forest parent/offset/scale entry reads recorded as collection_entry_visits and arithmetic separately.
diagnostics_not_added_to_primitive_price.primality_checks: Arithmetic/reductions recorded at implementation sites; check count is not operation price.
diagnostics_not_added_to_primitive_price.map_calls: API call diagnostic; comparison and traversal primitives carry native price.

distinct_passes: Bounds prevalidation and subsequent input canonicalization each consume entries and are counted separately. Map-to-vector conversion charges wrapper visit once plus explicit output-element copy, with no extra collection visit.
element_unit: Rust collection element; a tuple is one element, no byte-size expansion.
copy_initialization_disjoint: Explicit copy events are not also counted as fresh initialization. Ordinary collection value moves are not clone events.
nonclaims: No complete scientific price on rejection or cap
